proposals.summary: Tighten terminal queue-relief dispatch to route_queue >= 4.5 (the strongest supported probe) and add a max_other_route_queue >= 32 dispatch rule to clear cross-route backlogs.
proposals.rationale: The champion's biggest losses are left-behind riders on r3 at Old Main (peak queue 197) and on r2 at Central/Downtown, all of which are terminal-queue problems. The probe tightening queue-relief-dispatch to route_queue >= 4.5 is the single best measured change (-1.5%), and the max_other_route_queue >= 32 dispatch probe (-0.5%) targets the cross-route backlog at shared terminals; combining them should clear queues earlier without adding holds that penalize riders aboard. Both changes only make buses leave terminals sooner, so they cannot create long service gaps. Changes: Tighten queue-relief-dispatch threshold from route_queue >= 3 to route_queue >= 4.5; Add probe-term-disp-maxother-32 rule: dispatch at terminal when max_other_route_queue >= 32.

proposals.summary: Shift one bus from r1 to r2 (alloc 1/3/2) and lower the terminal queue-relief threshold from 3 to 2 to clear the Central/Downtown apartment queues.
proposals.rationale: The digest shows r2 is the second-most-pressured route, with 270 missed connections onto it (150 from r3 at Downtown) and 88 left behind at Central plus 91 at Downtown during stadium_exit, while r1 carries only 13 missed connections and 366 left behind. Moving a bus from r1 to r2 raises r2 frequency on the only route serving apts_north/apts_south, cutting both the Central transfer backlog and the Downtown queue. Lowering queue-relief-dispatch to route_queue>=2 dispatches r2/r3 buses earlier from terminals instead of sitting in layover, reducing the peak queues that cause left-behinds. Changes: params.allocation: r1 1, r2 3, r3 2 (one bus moved from least-pressured r1 to r2); queue-relief-dispatch threshold: route_queue >= 3 -> >= 2.

proposals.summary: Tighten queue-relief-dispatch to route_queue >= 4.5 and add a new terminal dispatch rule for max_other_route_queue >= 32.
proposals.rationale: Probe evidence supports both the tighter queue-relief threshold (about -1.5%) and a new max_other_route_queue >= 32 dispatch (about -0.5%); combining them should clear the 1% training bar. The tighter threshold reduces premature dispatches on routes that are not actually queued, while the new rule lets an idle terminal bus help relieve another route's queue without pulling r2 buses off Central (it just dispatches its own route sooner). Keeping the reassign-to-busiest rule preserves the strongest g2 gains. Changes: queue-relief-dispatch threshold moved from route_queue >= 3 to >= 4.5; new bus_at_terminal rule dispatch when max_other_route_queue >= 32.
